releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.194 remains unchanged. Web Update 338 improves the Me menu World Clock with searchable worldwide time-zone cities and add/remove controls. Existing Diary features and saved data are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: World Clock in the Diary Me menu now has searchable worldwide time-zone cities. Search by city or time-zone name and tap a result to add it; remove any added city. The live clock and existing Diary features remain unchanged.
